newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Martin seen returning as finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Martin seen returning as finance minister.

text.p: Canada's Finance Minister Paul Martin is likely to be reappointed for another term after the ruling Liberal Party was returned to power in Monday's election, Peter Donolo, spokesman for Prime Minister Jean Chretien, said on Tuesday.
Chretien indicated throughout the campaign that Martin, who has won international market credibility for the government with tough budget deficit cutting, would continue in his post.
Donolo noted that the decision to keep Martin on in his powerful post was up to Chretien. But he added: "I don't see any reason why he (Chretien) would change his mind."
The prime minister's spokesman said Chretien would announce his new cabinet next week.
Chretien has scheduled a news conference for Wednesday, a meeting of his current cabinet for Thursday, and a caucus meeting of all outgoing and incoming Liberal members of Parliament for next Monday.
